tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gter chen klong gsal snying po'i zab gter skor gyi srung ma'i gtor 'bul ni/1$0000300 raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ stong nyid ngang las rig rtsal rang shar ba'i// dam rdzas 'dod yon bzhed rgu'i dkor nor spel// ma tshangs med pa'i mthun rdzas rgya mtsho 'dis// dpal mgon tshogs bdag yab yum dregs pa'i 'khor// rgyal chen rnam sras blon po stag mda' gdong*// e ka tsā ti gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi// tshe ring mched lnga klu rgyal las gshin nag /rgyal chen g.yu phreng btsan rgod rol pa bdun// sha za kha mo che dang kong btsun ma// brtan ma bcu gnyis yang 'khor dregs pa'i tshogs// bka' dang gnas gter srung mdzad thams cad la// mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor 'bul// bstan dang bstan 'dzin rgyas shing zhabs pad brtan// mchog thun grub pa myur ba'i stongs grogs bcas// 'gal rkyen kun choms mthun rkyen yid bzhin sgrubs// gangs ljongs phan bde'i dge mtshan rgyas par mdzod//

rdo rje 'chang 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis bka' gnang ltar/ dza ka sprul ming pa 'jigs med kun bzang rnam rgyal pas rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba smon bzhin 'grub par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ/// /
